wrap.en: Please wrap the fragile model carefully before carrying it home.
wrap.zh: 把易碎模型帶回家前，請仔細包好。

wreck.en: The storm left an old boat wreck near the shore.
wreck.zh: 暴風雨在岸邊留下了一艘舊船殘骸。

wrestle.en: The students wrestle with a difficult question during discussion.
wrestle.zh: 學生在討論中努力思考一個困難問題。

wrinkle.en: One wrinkle appeared in the paper after it got wet.
wrinkle.zh: 紙張弄濕後出現了一道皺褶。

wrist.en: She wore a simple watch around her wrist at school.
wrist.zh: 她上學時在手腕上戴著一只簡單的手錶。

yacht.en: A white yacht moved slowly across the quiet harbor.
yacht.zh: 一艘白色遊艇緩緩駛過平靜的港灣。

yam.en: The market sold roasted yam during the cool evening.
yam.zh: 市場在涼爽的晚上販售烤地瓜。

yawn.en: A long yawn escaped him during the early lecture.
yawn.zh: 清早的講座中，他忍不住打了一個大哈欠。

yeah.en: Yeah, I remember where we placed the extra notebooks.
yeah.zh: 對，我記得我們把多的筆記本放在哪裡。

yearly.en: The club holds a yearly meeting to review its goals.
yearly.zh: 社團每年舉行一次會議檢視目標。

yearn.en: Many students yearn for more time to explore their interests.
yearn.zh: 許多學生渴望有更多時間探索自己的興趣。

yell.en: There is no need to yell across the quiet library.
yell.zh: 在安靜的圖書館裡沒有必要大聲喊叫。

yoga.en: The community center offers a beginner yoga class on weekends.
yoga.zh: 社區中心週末開設初學者瑜伽課。

yogurt.en: She added fresh fruit to plain yogurt for breakfast.
yogurt.zh: 她早餐把新鮮水果加入原味優格。

yolk.en: The egg yolk remained bright yellow after cooking.
yolk.zh: 蛋黃煮熟後仍呈現鮮黃色。

youngster.en: The museum designed a science corner for every curious youngster.
youngster.zh: 博物館為每位好奇的孩子設計了科學角落。

yours.en: This blue notebook is yours, not mine.
yours.zh: 這本藍色筆記本是你的，不是我的。

yourself.en: Give yourself enough time to check the final answer.
yourself.zh: 給自己足夠時間檢查最後答案。

yourselves.en: Please introduce yourselves before the group discussion begins.
yourselves.zh: 小組討論開始前，請先自我介紹。

youthful.en: The design has a youthful style that suits the school event.
youthful.zh: 這個設計帶有年輕活潑的風格，很適合校園活動。

zebra.en: The zoo introduced a young zebra in its grassland exhibit.
zebra.zh: 動物園在草原展區介紹了一隻年輕斑馬。

zipper.en: The zipper on my backpack broke during the field trip.
zipper.zh: 校外教學時，我背包上的拉鍊壞了。

zoo.en: Our class visited the zoo to study animal behavior.
zoo.zh: 我們班參觀動物園研究動物行為。

zoom.en: Use the controls to zoom in on the map details.
zoom.zh: 使用控制按鈕放大地圖細節。

abbey.en: The guide explained the history of the old abbey.
abbey.zh: 導遊說明了這座古老修道院的歷史。

abbreviation.en: NASA is an abbreviation formed from several English words.
abbreviation.zh: NASA 是由幾個英文單字組成的縮寫。

abolition.en: The lesson discussed the abolition of an outdated legal practice.
abolition.zh: 課堂討論了一項過時法律制度的廢除。

absorbing.en: The documentary was absorbing enough to hold everyone's attention.
absorbing.zh: 這部紀錄片很引人入勝，吸引了所有人的注意。

acceleration.en: The graph shows the car's acceleration over several seconds.
acceleration.zh: 圖表顯示汽車數秒內的加速度變化。

accomplished.en: She is an accomplished pianist who also teaches younger students.
accomplished.zh: 她是一位有成就的鋼琴家，也教導年幼學生。

ace.en: He hopes to ace the quiz after a week of review.
ace.zh: 複習一週後，他希望能把小考考得很好。

acreage.en: The report lists the farm acreage used for vegetables.
acreage.zh: 報告列出農場用來種植蔬菜的面積。

adjoin.en: Two classrooms adjoin the new science laboratory.
adjoin.zh: 兩間教室與新的科學實驗室相連。

advancement.en: The invention represented a major advancement in communication technology.
advancement.zh: 這項發明代表通訊科技的一大進步。

advert.en: The magazine placed an advert beside the travel article.
advert.zh: 雜誌在旅遊文章旁放了一則廣告。

advertising.en: The course examines how advertising influences consumer choices.
advertising.zh: 這門課探討廣告如何影響消費者選擇。

aerospace.en: The university opened a new aerospace research laboratory.
aerospace.zh: 大學新設了一間航太研究實驗室。

affiliated.en: The school is affiliated with several international education groups.
affiliated.zh: 這所學校與數個國際教育團體有合作關係。

aftermath.en: The town repaired roads in the aftermath of the storm.
aftermath.zh: 暴風雨過後，城鎮修復了道路。

aging.en: The article discusses challenges created by an aging population.
aging.zh: 文章討論人口老化帶來的挑戰。

aide.en: The teacher's aide prepared materials before the science activity.
aide.zh: 教學助理在科學活動前準備教材。

airforce.en: The history book includes a chapter about the national airforce.
airforce.zh: 歷史課本有一章介紹國家空軍。

airmail.en: The old letter was originally sent overseas by airmail.
airmail.zh: 這封老信最初是用航空郵件寄到海外。

akin.en: Her idea is akin to one discussed in yesterday's lesson.
akin.zh: 她的想法與昨天課堂討論的一個觀點相似。

alarming.en: The report showed an alarming rise in plastic waste.
alarming.zh: 報告顯示塑膠垃圾出現令人擔憂的增加。

alas.en: Alas, the outdoor concert was canceled because of heavy rain.
alas.zh: 唉，戶外音樂會因大雨而取消。

albeit.en: The task was useful, albeit more difficult than expected.
albeit.zh: 這項任務很有幫助，雖然比預期更困難。

alienation.en: The novel explores feelings of alienation in a changing city.
alienation.zh: 小說探討人在變動城市中的疏離感。

allegation.en: The report treated each allegation carefully before drawing conclusions.
allegation.zh: 報告在下結論前仔細處理每項指控。

allied.en: The two research teams became allied through a shared project.
allied.zh: 兩個研究團隊因共同專題而結盟合作。
